Title: Rules questions: Antithesis, XTC-laced blood, and tapped vampires.

Messages.Author: George
Messages.Body:
A vampire has XtC-laced blood and Antithesis, but is tapped when
entering the minion phase. Does the vampire go to torpor? The text on
XtC-laced blood says "must hunt", but does that apply only to untapped
vampires? Antithesis says "tap and go to torpor" - can this happen if
the vampire is already tapped?

--George

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
George wrote:
> A vampire has XtC-laced blood and Antithesis, but is tapped when
> entering the minion phase. Does the vampire go to torpor?

No.

> The text on
> XtC-laced blood says "must hunt", but does that apply only to untapped
> vampires?

Yes.

> Antithesis says "tap and go to torpor" - can this happen if
> the vampire is already tapped?

It could, but the condition for that effect renders the question moot.
